title: vibeic.ppa.metric.v1 — the canonical PPA metric record
description: The shape every number in the PPA system travels in, frozen in docs/PPA_INTERFACES.md section 2. THE INVARIANT THIS SCHEMA EXISTS TO ENFORCE: 0, -1 and "" never mean 'not measured'. A number that was not obtained is a record with status NOT_MEASURED and a reason, and it carries NO `value` key -- not `value: null`, which survives .get() as a present key and re-enters arithmetic as `or 0`. SECOND INVARIANT: comparability is a property of `scope`, not of the metric name; two records naming the same metric under different scope are different facts. This file is versioned by filename: v1 is never edited once something has hashed against it, and a change is v2 (PPA_INTERFACES section 5). The authoritative ENFORCER is programs/_ppa/metrics.py::validate, which is dependency-free; test_ppa_metrics_schema_agreement.py proves the two agree on one fixture corpus, so this document can never drift into decoration.

schema.description: First key of every instance document.

metric.description: Dotted lowercase name, at least two segments, e.g. 'timing.setup.wns_ns'. DELIBERATELY NOT AN ENUM: a closed list of metric names would have to be edited by every domain author who adds a metric, which makes this file a contention point and guarantees the list trails the tree. The first segment is the domain and is used for grouping only; it is never interpreted.

status.description: Section 6.2. The enum is CLOSED: a reader that does not recognise a status cannot know whether the row may enter arithmetic, so an unknown one is refused rather than assumed safe. MEASURED and DERIVED may enter a numeric comparison; NOT_MEASURED, NOT_APPLICABLE and INVALID may not and carry a reason instead of a value; ESTIMATED carries a value but is never part of a final PPA claim -- it stays a distinct status rather than being banned so that an estimate which leaked into a bundle is VISIBLE as an estimate instead of being relabelled MEASURED by whoever wanted the row to count.

value.description: The number. Present ONLY for MEASURED, DERIVED and ESTIMATED. Never null: null is a present key, and a present key is not an absence.

unit.description: A non-empty unit string. The empty string is not a unit -- it compares equal to another empty unit, so two numbers in different units pass a unit check. Where the metric NAME ends in a recognised unit suffix, programs/_ppa/metrics.py additionally requires the two to agree; that cross-check is not expressible in JSON Schema without enumerating the taxonomy here, which this file deliberately does not do.

reason.description: Why there is no number. Required for NOT_MEASURED, NOT_APPLICABLE and INVALID. Without it the row is indistinguishable from a row nobody thought about, and a NOT_APPLICABLE with no reason is how a metric somebody could not obtain gets excused permanently.

formula.description: Required for DERIVED. Section 3: a number this system computed states its formula, so a reader can recompute it instead of trusting it.

inputs.description: Optional for DERIVED: the metric names this value was computed from.

basis.description: Required for ESTIMATED: what the estimate rests on.

scope.description: What makes two numbers comparable. Synthesis area and post-route area are different metrics; vectorless power and VCD power are different metrics; a different corner, mode or activity basis is a different fact. `stage` is the only universally required field -- corner, mode and clock fields are required by the DOMAIN that owns the metric, because a die-area record has no clock and demanding one would force a domain author to invent a value, which is how a scope field becomes decorative. Every declared field must be non-empty: an empty scope field is the third sentinel one level in, since "" == "" makes two records with an unknown corner compare as the same corner. And a WORD for the same silence is the same defect a third time: "unknown" == "unknown" the way null == null does, while satisfying both minLength and the required-key test. A field a producer could not establish is OMITTED and named in `scope_gaps`.

source.description: Provenance. Required for MEASURED: a number with no provenance cannot be checked against the artefact it came from, which is the entire contract. `sha256` is of the ARTEFACT bytes; the identity of the record itself is computed with _ppa/canonical_json.py and is never hand-rolled.

scope_gaps.description: Why each ABSENT scope key is absent -- one sentence per key, OUTSIDE `scope` so it cannot make two records compare equal. An omitted key that says nothing is the same silence one field over: "this view has no RC corner axis" and "nobody recorded one" are different facts and a reader cannot tell them apart from a hole.

allOf.description: MEASURED: a value, a unit and a source.
DERIVED: a value, a unit and the formula that produced it.
ESTIMATED: a value, a unit and the basis of the estimate.
THE FOURTH INVARIANT. A non-measurement carries a reason and MUST NOT carry a value. This is the clause that stops 0 from meaning 'not measured'.
